children: looks neutral in a range of $92.40 to $94.07 per barrel, and an escape could suggest a direction.
It is hard to classify the rise during the previous trading session, which could simply be a bounce against the fall from $96.78 or an extension of the uptrend from the November 10 low of $89.16.
A break above $94.07 may confirm the extension scenario and open the way toward the $94.71 to $95.11 range, while a break below $92.40 could trigger a fall into the $90.87 to $91.36 range.
On the daily chart, the contract seems to be consolidating within a bigger neutral range of $89.91-$96.57. Trending signals may remain unclear before it gets out of the range.
A continuation of the downtrend will be confirmed when the market breaks $89.91. A further bounce above $96.57 may be limited to a zone of $99.67-$104.81.
